AssertCanControl in SessionManager.cs only null-checks its arguments. It never verifies session ownership or the EnableRemoteControlOfOtherUsers permission. All the session remote-control endpoints are bare [Authorize], so any authenticated user who knows a target session ID can send popups, control playback, and issue system commands to another user's client. Session IDs are MD5(clientName + deviceId), so they can be computed offline rather than stolen.
